abstract: Verifies cryogenic warehousing and cold-chain temperature monitoring protocols
system_message:
You are the Cold chain logistics manager (LOG), responsible for verifying cryogenic warehousing and cold-chain temperature monitoring protocols as well as evaluating secondary courier qualification across biopharmaceutical manufacturing facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies cryogenic warehousing and cold-chain temperature monitoring protocols（DIST）
information_points.content:
LOG-DIST-TS9：For Ringaskiddy Cell Therapeutics Facility, the validated -80 °C cold-chain transport integrity guarantee is confirmed (true) with the hold duration measurement basis evaluated as elapsed time starting at shipper pack-out completion for bulk drug substance pallet shipments to the secondary fill-finish hub.
LOG-DIST-7EB：For BioCork Advanced Biologics Campus, the validated -80 °C cold-chain transport integrity guarantee is confirmed (true) based on a hold duration measurement basis of elapsed time starting at shipper pack-out completion for bulk drug substance pallet shipments to the secondary fill-finish hub.
LOG-DIST-FQA：For Shannon Bioprocess Manufacturing Center, the validated -80 °C cold-chain transport integrity guarantee is not provided (false) under the hold duration measurement basis of elapsed time starting at shipper pack-out completion for bulk drug substance pallet shipments to the secondary fill-finish hub.
LOG-DIST-82W：For BioCork Advanced Biologics Campus, the validated -80 °C cold-chain transport integrity guarantee is not established (false) when using the hold duration measurement basis of elapsed time starting at carrier departure for bulk drug substance pallet shipments to the secondary fill-finish hub.

information_points.title: Secondary courier qualification（FLEET）
information_points.content:
LOG-FLEET-SS2：Per the fleet mapping qualification log for active dedicated refrigerated transport vehicles, Ringaskiddy Cell Therapeutics Facility records a reefer vehicle qualification rate of 100% of dedicated delivery vans passing annual multi-point thermal mapping.
LOG-FLEET-MZL：The fleet mapping qualification log for active dedicated refrigerated transport vehicles shows that Shannon Bioprocess Manufacturing Center achieves an 85% reefer vehicle qualification rate based on annual multi-point thermal mapping passes.
LOG-FLEET-F0Y：The fleet mapping qualification log for active dedicated refrigerated transport vehicles indicates that BioCork Advanced Biologics Campus has a reefer vehicle qualification rate of 92%, representing the proportion of dedicated delivery vans passing annual multi-point thermal mapping.
